instruction: Refer to freecad_task-18_input.step in FreeCAD. Launch FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad` and open `freecad_task-18_input.step` there. Use the Part Design workbench for the modeling operations; activate or create the relevant Body, create new sketches for sketch-based features, and use feature or placement tools for the requested edits. Cut a true undercut dovetail slot through the full 80 mm length along X. Center the slot at Y=20 mm on the top face. Make the top opening 16 mm wide and the bottom 26 mm wide at a depth of 10 mm, so each sidewall expands outward by 5 mm over the 10 mm depth (26.565 degrees from vertical). Export the dovetail block as /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-18_output.step.
